rationale: Low per-token cost for a bounded single-turn Q&A endpoint at Week 1 scope, where the deliverable is a working /ask contract with observable tokens_used/cost_usd rather than answer quality tuned across models. Revisit once VERA's evidence-context pipeline (Session 2+) makes response quality, not just cost, a load-bearing evaluation dimension.
